title_alternatives: Stop Counting Your Net Worth Wrong ($127K Mistake)
The 3 Ways You're Lying to Yourself About Your Net Worth
youtube_short.description: Most people calculate their net worth completely wrong — and the gap between your paper number and your real spendable wealth is shocking. Your 401k balance? The IRS owns 22-32% of it. Your home equity? 8-9% walks out the door the moment you sell. Your car? It lost $5,000 last year and it'll lose $4,000 this year. Add it up and the average American with $500K in 'net worth' has about $370K in actual accessible wealth. Track your after-tax, after-cost net worth — it's the only number that matters for your retirement plan. #networth #personalfinance #moneytips #401k #wealthbuilding
